art_direction.concept: A clear observation sheet about a learning room
signature: A stable relationship between the heading and the image edge
fixed: The same source photograph and visible factual anchors
Readable text and preserved image proportions
flexible: Composition, type scale, palette, crop, and one image edge in this explicitly fictional study
avoid: Invented outcomes, testimonials, or handwritten evidence
Decorative motifs without a content role

organic.reason: The audience needs to compare visible features, not interpret an expressive gesture.

visual_intent.composition: Wide image beside three aligned observations
visual_intent.rationale: The audience needs to compare visible features, not interpret an expressive gesture.
visual_intent.repeat_intent: The same image is intentionally reused across alternative briefs in a controlled study, not repeated in a production deck.
